_comment: Reading plans. Each track spreads a run of books (OSIS codes, inclusive) evenly over the plan's days; several tracks are read side by side.

plans.name: The Bible in a Year
plans.blurb: Genesis to Revelation, about three chapters a day.

plans.name: Old and New Together
plans.blurb: A year through the whole Bible, an Old Testament and a New Testament reading each day.

plans.name: The Bible in 90 Days
plans.blurb: The whole story at a sprint: about thirteen chapters a day.

plans.name: New Testament in 90 Days
plans.blurb: Matthew to Revelation, three chapters a day.

plans.name: The Gospels in 30 Days
plans.blurb: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John in a month.

plans.name: John in 21 Days
plans.blurb: A chapter a day with the beloved disciple.

plans.name: Acts in 28 Days
plans.blurb: The church is born and goes to the ends of the earth.

plans.name: Romans in 16 Days
plans.blurb: The gospel laid out, one chapter a day.

plans.name: Genesis in 50 Days
plans.blurb: In the beginning, a chapter a day.

plans.name: Psalms and Proverbs
plans.blurb: A month of praise and wisdom: five psalms and a proverb a day.

plans.name: A Proverb a Day
plans.blurb: One chapter of Proverbs for each day of the month.
